newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says M3 growth down to 17.1 pct in March.
newsitem.headline: Manila says M3 growth down to 17.1 pct in March.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Friday growth of domestic liquidity, M3, fell to 17.1 percent in March from 20.5 percent in March 1996.
Domestic liquidity is the sum of currency in circulation, deposits and deposit substitutes.
Central Bank deputy governor Edgardo Zialcita said base money and reserve money were kept about 10 billion pesos below their targeted levels for the period.

"These encouraging developments in the monetary front should help reinforce the prospects for appropriate credit growth in the ensuing months as well as continued stability in consumer price movements," Zialcita said in a statement.
